limitations: Native2–16 opaque equal-sized exposure brackets,16MP/image and32MP combined. API2–7 explicitly shared sources,4MP canvas/64layers/128MiB and one free output share slot; document-transfer permission required.

Sources flatten and convert to sRGB camera/display range; converted out-of-gamut colors clamp. Extended-range HDR sources and transparency reject explicitly. Output32-bit is linear sRGB;16/8-bit is tone-mapped sRGB. Original documents/files/history stay unchanged.
Exposure metadata requires finite positive time/aperture/ISO; missing metadata requires manual EV or explicit image estimation. Native EV range−20…20 and relative exposure limit40stops.

Ward bitmap translation alignment with normalized correlation tie-break, reference-frame canvas, alpha-aware missing edges. Coarse alignment is bounded to1536px with five pyramid levels; rotation/projective/lens correction and difficult/large production cases remain open.

Camera response uses160 spatial/intensity samples and256code values/channel with native Accelerate. Original Rust radiance/response fixture has<0.01% relative sample and<0.00001 curve tolerance; this is not Photoshop equality.

Four tone operators and native ghost-base selection are usable; preset/response-curve exchange, complete Photoshop defaults/two-stage dialog, HDR Toning and32-bit preview-options commands remain separate work. Display-only preview exposure is observable through the API but never alters output samples.

Native NSHosting tests are offscreen. Live Photato/Photoshop, physical Intel/macOS14/26, exact proprietary output and complete parity remain open. Smart Object image-stack statistics is next major work.
